plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: Live progress for Claude's helper agents: a band above the prompt and the /agents-info panel (crabs in tier hats, steps, tokens, rough cost, time).

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds a destructive shell command once with exactly what it would delete; never deletes the repo, .git or home, never force-pushes the default branch.

plugins.name: second-look
plugins.description: A second Claude reviews every merge or push to the default branch against the repo's CLAUDE.md and holds it once on blocking findings.

plugins.name: heads-up
plugins.description: After each long reply, a side panel with the 2-4 lines that need you (things to look at, things to do, ideas); point at a line (tap ⓘ on a phone) to see why.

plugins.name: release-guard
plugins.description: Play next's release rules (APP_V, WHATS_NEW, LOG, helper, files) on every commit and merge; on only in a repo that carries .claude/skills/release-guard.

plugins.name: learn
plugins.description: Claude's lessons in docs/LESSONS.md: retrospectives after mistakes, lessons shown where they apply; on only in a repo that carries .claude/skills/learn.

plugins.name: bug-inbox
plugins.description: Open auto-bug issues at chat start and new hand-filed reports as they arrive; on only in a repo that carries .claude/skills/bug-inbox.

plugins.name: auto-handoff
plugins.description: Past 300k tokens, records the chat's lessons and starts a fresh chat with a handoff note; on only in a repo that carries .claude/skills/auto-handoff.

plugins.name: auto-pull
plugins.description: At chat start, fast-forwards the current branch when it is only behind GitHub; never merges or touches uncommitted work.
